title: Voice and chat
covers: Voice and phone agents, chatbots, RAG assistants and messaging bots that hold a conversation with people.

stakeholders.who: The customer talking to the voice agent or chatbot
would_notice: a long pause before every answer
being talked over, or not being able to interrupt

stakeholders.who: The business the assistant speaks for
would_notice: a wrong price or opening hour
an answer to a question outside the business
an outbound call or SMS they never approved

stakeholders.who: The colleague who receives the handoff or notification
cares_about: one notification with everything needed to act
would_notice: a notification without a callback number or the reason for the call

first_ten_seconds: Listen to or read the greeting: does it say it is an AI, in the caller's language, and ask one clear question?
Ask something it cannot know: does it say so and offer a person instead of guessing?
Interrupt it (voice) or send a short unclear message (chat): does it recover naturally?

checks.claim: Answers about the business come from its approved sources and cite them where the channel allows; nothing is invented.
checks.how_to_inspect: Ask ten real customer questions with known answers and compare each answer with its source.
checks.evidence_required: The question set with answers and sources.

source.quote: answers are source-aware and cite their sources

checks.claim: When retrieval is empty or unsure it says so and offers a person or a callback, instead of guessing.
checks.how_to_inspect: Ask three questions the sources cannot answer and read or listen to each reply.
checks.evidence_required: The three replies, quoted or recorded.

source.quote: Clear fallback response when retrieval is empty/low-confidence — no guessing.

checks.claim: Each turn asks at most one question and stays short enough to follow by ear.
checks.how_to_inspect: Read the transcript of a full test conversation and count the questions per turn.
checks.evidence_required: The transcript with any multi-question turn marked.

checks.claim: It speaks the caller's language as configured (Dutch-first for Dutch clients), in natural spoken phrasing rather than written text read aloud, and says names and numbers correctly.
checks.how_to_inspect: Listen to a recorded test call (or read the chat) as a native speaker and note stiff phrasing and mispronounced names, times and prices.
checks.evidence_required: The recording or transcript and the notes.

source.quote: Dutch-first caller experience verified (spoken-natural, correct voice)

checks.claim: The caller hears or reads early that they are talking to an AI, and any recording consent is handled.
checks.how_to_inspect: Check the first turn of a test conversation for the disclosure and the consent wording.
checks.evidence_required: The first turn of the transcript.

checks.claim: Response time was measured on real turns (and barge-in tested for voice); there are no long silences.
checks.how_to_inspect: Time ten turns from the end of the user's input to the start of the reply.

checks.claim: The conversation ends politely when the task is done, and never loops or keeps the user talking.
checks.how_to_inspect: Finish a test conversation and check the closing turn and that nothing follows it.
checks.evidence_required: The last turns of the transcript.

checks.claim: Questions outside the business are declined politely instead of answered.
checks.how_to_inspect: Ask two unrelated questions (general knowledge, another company) and read the replies.
checks.evidence_required: The two replies, quoted or recorded.

checks.claim: No outbound calls, SMS or proactive messages are enabled without the owner's approval.
checks.how_to_inspect: Read the configuration for outbound, SMS and broadcast features and confirm each is off or approved.

source.quote: No outbound/SMS/customer traffic enabled without owner approval

checks.claim: One conversation produces at most one notification, also when a turn is retried.
checks.how_to_inspect: Run a test conversation, retry one turn, and count the notifications sent.

checks.claim: The notification holds what staff need to act without replaying the call: name, callback number, reason, requested time and a transcript link.
checks.how_to_inspect: Read the test notification as the colleague who must act on it.
checks.evidence_required: The notification text with any missing item named.

source.rationale: Staff act on the notification, not the recording; a missing callback number turns a lead into a lost lead.

checks.claim: Voice, tone and form of address fit the business, and stock phrases are not repeated every turn.
checks.how_to_inspect: Read a full transcript and mark repeated phrases and any tone that does not fit the brief.

source.rationale: Callers notice a repeated stock phrase within two turns and stop trusting the assistant.

common_sloppy_defects.symptom: 'What is your name, and when would you like to come, and for how many people?'
an invented opening time instead of 'I do not know; shall I have someone call you?'
bullet points, URLs or 'e.g.' spoken by the voice
one call produces three e-mails to the office
the assistant keeps asking 'Is there anything else?' after the caller said goodbye
